# 3 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> This beautifully presented and thoughtfully decorated three bed semi-detached property is situated in the sought after location of Harestock; finished to an excellent standard throughout. Ground Floor: The ground floor begins with a welcoming and beautifully decorated hallway. There is a downstairs cloakroom and large under stairs storage cupboard.
